obernants.assumptions: Source-derived effect relations assume stated external success and resource availability. No downloaded corpus and no real DB executable are used. Existing robots_rules is excluded because its negative hostname resolves DNS.
obernants.domain: Bounded synthetic UTF-8 strings, small owned temporary files/archives and valid finite nonnegative delays; nonoverflowing counters and valid Done indices. Actual tests execute no network or DNS, live catalogs, model/teacher or database.
obernants.observation_scope: Real joins: raw::License::code and books::BookLicense::code match fetch's finite allowed strings; raw inputs match OAI gzip page naming; HTTP encode transports literal token bytes; robots uses Polite and fetch invokes Gate before downloading. Counterexample: GCS JSON numeric size becomes zero; it is not raw KB format. Book build's DNS means offline TSV construction is not a pure parser. SQL filling is sequential substitution, not DB semantics.
obernants.operator: Inner exclusions: invalid fetch list/license prevents download setup; terminal OAI token prevents request; unknown raw license host cannot map Open. Across tagged paths these exclusions apply only to the selected route and preconditions, not every caller.
